HEADLINE: Malpani Pipes And Fittings Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 18/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve & take on record ....
MORE:
Malpani Pipes And Fittings Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 18/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve & take on record the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the half year ended on September 30, 2026 as per Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and any other items as may be decided by the Board of Directors.

In this connection and in continuation of our intimation regarding Closure of Trading Window for the Insiders of the Company vide letter dated September 28, 2026, the trading window for dealing in the securities of the Company is already closed for the Insiders of the Company since Thursday, October 01, 2026 and the same will be re-opened after 48 hours of the declaration and publication of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the half year ended on September 30, 2026.

HEADLINE: Malpani Pipes And Fittings Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 14/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve & take on record ....
MORE:
Malpani Pipes And Fittings Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 14/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve & take on record the Unaudited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the half year ended on September 30, 2026 as per Regulation 33 of the Listing Regulation and any other items as may be decided by the Board of Directors.
Further, pursuant to provisions of the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 as amended and the Company's Code of Conduct to Regulate, Monitor and Report Trading by Insiders, the trading window for dealing in securities of the Company is already closed from Thursday, October 01, 2026 for all Designated Persons and their immediate relatives and the same will be re-opened after 48 hours of the declaration and publication of Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the half year September 30, 2026.
